headline: Shipped all 6 audit items and root-caused a recurring silent failure where every closeout stranded its own Cloudflare Pages deploy.

items.title: CF Pages [skip ci]-tip deploy-strand fix
items.insight: The /status/ measured-win tile was dark on prod even though the data was confirmed and the renderer correct — Pages skips [skip ci] tips, and the closeout autopilot's reconcile commit was always the tip, so every session quietly stranded its own deploy. One guard retroactively un-freezes a pipeline that had been failing in silence for multiple sessions. It almost certainly affects other Pages-hosted sibling repos too.
items.evidence: check-deploy-tip.mjs 7/7 self-test + closeout-autopilot empty-deploy-trigger guard; prod was serving hasConfirmed:false against a confirmed origin/main.

items.title: Self-grading proof manifest (8 fetches → 1)
items.insight: Ten blind proof fetches on /status/ became one manifest that grades its own freshness — each signal carries its age and a stale flag, with a top-level trust score. A visitor or an AI agent can now verify the studio's entire live posture in a single request instead of stitching ten files together.
items.evidence: build-status-proof.mjs → api/status-proof.json (trust 90%, 10/10 feeds); getProof shim + freshness tile + rel=alternate link; wired into build:check.

items.title: Proven Worker disaster-recovery failover
items.insight: The double-5xx DR cache that serves stale HTML during an outage was asserted in code but never exercised. Four hermetic tests now prove it degrades gracefully — including the hang case — so a regression fails CI instead of surfacing during the next real outage.
items.evidence: 21/21 worker.unit.spec passing; injected fetchImpl/cachesImpl, zero network.

items.title: Rebase guard on 7 self-committing workflows
items.insight: The P0 carry blamed one workflow, but seven push without rebasing first and can all lose the same race. Fixing the class instead of the instance stops the benign-but-trust-eroding CI failures at the source.
items.evidence: git pull --rebase --autostash before push in all 7; every YAML validated.

items.title: Honest AMBER Trusted-Types reprobe
items.insight: Security posture is only real when it's measured on a cadence. The reprobe came back AMBER — 148 violations still present — so the enforce flip was deferred with a named burn-down plan rather than flipped on hope. The default-policy bridge keeps the site working in the meantime.
items.evidence: docs/TT_ENFORCE_READINESS_2026-06-10.md; top sink journal/dispatches:364 is ~20% of volume.

items.title: Committed reason-coded ambient ledger
items.insight: Every ambient-split wave re-litigated which engine belongs in the cold path from a volatile cache. A committed ledger derived from the live bundle arrays makes the next wave a lookup, not an investigation, and surfaces four split-candidates with their gates.
items.evidence: build-ambient-ledger.mjs → docs/AMBIENT_LEDGER.md (21 sources, 4 candidates); build:check drift gate.

followUps: Verify prod (pages.dev): field-win tile lights + /api/status-proof.json live
Ark-broadcast the deploy-strand pattern to CF-Pages siblings (likely fleet-wide)
TT named-policy wave on 4 first-party sinks → clean GREEN enforce-flip
